value.rationale: The probability that a far-right particle currently travels left is a natural kinematic diagnostic, invisible in position-only resetting distributions. The strict exponent-dependent limiting curve and exact α=3/2 fraction answer a specific physically motivated question uniformly, not a selected finite example. Quantitative co-exceedance and all mixed-moment thresholds distinguish joint fluctuations from marginal tails.
